name: bayarea-driving-env
description: Multi-agent driving environment of the San Francisco Bay Area (SF <-> San Jose) built from OpenStreetMap + USGS 3DEP elevation: full vehicle dynamics, rigid-body crashes, real traffic controls. Plain ES modules, no build step, no dependencies.

scripts.build:tiles: [ -f data/roads-local.json ] || npm run unpack; [ -f data/junctions.bin ] || npm run build:junctions; [ -f data/lines.bin ] || npm run build:lines; node --max-old-space-size=14000 tools/tiles/build_tiles.mjs
scripts.build:landscape: ([ -f data/roads.json ] && [ -f data/roads-local.json ]) || npm run unpack; node tools/landscape/build_all.mjs
scripts.build:render: npm run build:tiles && npm run build:landscape
